answer: Precondition: every identity must be auditable without warning. Each epoch a random sample of submissions is re-executed by peers who did not grade them, and the result converts into a slow vesting stream instead of a lump payment. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, so a replay from another account fails the signature check at the door. A farm on some quiet knoll dodges one draw, not a season of them; each failed audit burns the quill and resets the ocean of vested weight.
